items.title: Branford Marsalis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: You can read Jelly Roll Morton’s book. I mean you can hear his oral history

ctx.x: Now did you have playmates, or other friends who were also involved in music?

Not involved in music, but, unlike most cities in America, being a musician is cool in New Orleans and the surrounding area. Or, as we say down there, “Oh yeah Bruh, you play that music, huh?” I mean they…. It’s like there’s this whole thing that I saw in movies and had other conversations with…. Like the term “band fag,” I mean I didn’t even know what that was. Some guy, when I was in college, said, “Oh, you know, I was a band fag.” I said, “What’s a band fag?” You know? He said, “Aw, you know, that’s what they…
Mr. Jelly Roll, or Pops Foster.
